comments.author: albertbou92
comments.body:
After looking into it further, I noticed that `TorchRL` uses `set_list_to_stack` as a decorator here for the `LLMEnv`:
https://github.com/pytorch/rl/blob/main/torchrl/envs/llm/envs.py#L681

It seems like my version of `ChatEnv` class could do something similar.

If that is the intended solution, I will go ahead and close this issue.

But I see here that the stack behavior will be on by default in the future, so maybe what I am seeing becomes an issue in the future.
https://github.com/pytorch/tensordict/blob/e03c25eb8b8efd45bc2801611300298208145059/tensordict/utils.py#L2051
